arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي طَلَبِ الْعَفْوِ و المَغْفِرَةِ
english_title: 39. His supplication in seeking Pardon & Mercy

phrases.english: 1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.break my passion for every unlawful thing,
3.take away my craving for any sin,

phrases.arabic: وَامْنَعْنِي عَنْ أَذَى كُـلِّ مُؤْمِن وَمُؤْمِنَـة وَمُسْلِم وَمُسْلِمَة،
phrases.english: 4.and bar me from harming any believer, male or female, and any Muslim, male or female!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْد نالَ مِنِّي مَا حَظَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: 5.O God, if any of Your servants should harm me in what You hast forbidden
6.or violate me in what You hast interdicted,
7.and if he should pass into death with my complaint
8.or I come to have a complaint against him while he is alive,

phrases.arabic: فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ مَا أَلَمَّ بِهِ مِنِّي،
phrases.english: 9.forgive him what he did to me

phrases.arabic: وَاعْفُ لَهُ عَمَّا أَدْبَرَ بِهِ عَنِّي،
phrases.english: 10.and pardon him that through which he turned his back on me!

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَقِفْـهُ عَلَى مَا  ارْتَكَبَ فِيَّ،
phrases.english: 11.Inquire not from him about what he committed toward me
12.and expose him not through what he earned by me!

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مَا سَمَحْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعَفْـوِ عَنْهُمْ
phrases.english: 13.Make my open-handedness in pardoning such servants
14.and my contribution in charity toward them
15.the purest charity of the charitable
16.and the highest gift of those seeking nearness to You!
17.Recompense me for my pardoning them with Your pardon
18.and for my supplicating for them with Your mercy

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى يَسْعَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِد مِنَّا بِفَضْلِكَ
phrases.english: 19.so that each one of us may gain felicity through Your bounty
20.and each may attain deliverance through Your kindness!
21.O God, if there is a servant from among Your servants

phrases.arabic: أدرَكَهُ مِنِّي دَرَكٌ أَوْ مَسَّهُ مِنْ نَاحِيَتِي أَذَىً،
phrases.english: 22.whom an ill visits on my account, a harm touches from my direction,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ لَحِقَـهُ بِي أَوْ بِسَبَبي ظُلْمٌ
phrases.english: 23.or a wrong overtakes through me or because of me,
24.and should I fail to take care of his right
25.or go before him [in death] with his complaint,
26.bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَأَرْضِهِ عَنِّي مِنْ وُجْدِكَ، وَأَوْفِهِ حَقَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ،
phrases.english: 27.satisfy him toward me through Your wealth, and give him his full right from Yourself!

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ قِنيْ مَا يُوجِبُ لَهُ حُكْمُكَ،
phrases.english: 28.Then protect me from what Your decision mandates
29.and save me from what Your justice decides,
30.for my strength cannot bear Your vengeance
31.and my power cannot stand up to Your displeasure!
32.If You recompensest me with the right, You wilt destroy me,
33.and if You dost not shield me in Your mercy, You wilt lay me waste.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي مَا لا يَنْقُصُكَ بَذْلُهُ،
phrases.english: 34.O God, I ask You to grant, my God, that whose giving will not decrease You,
35.and I ask You to carry that whose carrying will not weigh You down:

phrases.arabic: أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي نَفْسِيَ الَّتِيْ لَمْ تَخْلُقْهَا لِتَمْتَنِعَ بِهَا  مِنْ سُوء،
phrases.english: 36.My God, I ask You to give my soul, which You didst not create to keep Yourself from evil
37.nor to find the way to profit.

phrases.arabic: وَلكِنْ أَنْشَأتَهَا إثْبَاتاً لِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا،
phrases.english: 38.No, You brought it forth to demonstrate Your power over its like
39.and to provide an argument against its similar.

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ،
phrases.english: 40.I ask You to carry those of my sins whose carrying weighs me down

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا قَدْ فَدَحَنِي ثِقْلُهُ.
phrases.english: 41.and I seek help from You in that whose heaviness oppresses me.
42.So bless Muhammad and his Household,
43.give to me my soul in spite of its wrongdoing,
44.and appoint Your mercy to carry my burden!
45.How many evildoers Your mercy has overtaken!
46.How many wrongdoers Your pardon has embraced!

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي أُسْوَةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَنْهَضْتَهُ
phrases.english: 47.So bless Muhammad and his Household and make me the model of him whom You hast aroused
48.through Your forbearance from the deadly infirmities of the offenders
49.and saved through Your giving success from the tangled plights of the sinners,

phrases.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَ طَلِيقَ عَفْوِكَ مِنْ إسَارِ سُخْطِكَ،
phrases.english: 50.so that I may rise up freed by Your pardon from the bonds of Your displeasure
51.and released by Your benefaction from the ties of Your justice!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ إنْ تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ يَا إلهِي تَفْعَلْهُ بِمَنْ
phrases.english: 52.Surely if You dost that, my God, You wilt do it to one
53.who does not deny deserving Your punishment

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يُبَرِّئُ نَفْسَهُ  مِنِ اسْتِيجَابِ نَقِمَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 54.or acquit himself from merit for Your vengeance.

phrases.arabic: تَفْعَلُ ذلِكَ يَا إلهِي بِمَنْ خَوْفُهُ مِنْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ طَمَعِهِ فِيكَ،
phrases.english: 55.Do that, my God, for one whose fear of You is greater than his craving from You,

phrases.arabic: وَبِمَنْ يَأْسُهُ مِنَ النَّجَاةِ أَوْكَدُ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ لِلْخَلاَصِ،
phrases.english: 56.whose hopelessness of deliverance is firmer than his hope for salvation!
57.Not that his hopelessness is despair,
58.nor that his expectation is deluded.
59.No, rather his good deeds are few among his evil deeds
60.and his arguments are frail in face of everything due from his acts.

phrases.arabic: فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي فَأَهْلٌ أَنْ
phrases.english: 61.But Thou, my God, art worthy that
62.the righteous not be deluded concerning You
63.and the sinners not lose hope in You,

phrases.arabic: لاَِنَّكَ ألرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِيْ لاَ يَمْنَعُ أَحَداً فَضْلَهُ
phrases.english: 64.for You art the All-mighty Lord who holds back His bounty from none
65.and takes His full right from no one.
66.High exalted is Your mention above those mentioned!
67.Holy are Your names beyond those described!
68.Spread is Your favour among all creatures!

phrases.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
phrases.english: 69.Thine is the praise for that, O Lord of the worlds!
